# Combined accessibility over MATSim facility types

One accessibility value per person across all 12 facility activity types,
weighted by the share of time the population spends at each activity
(`typical_duration_share` above):
combined = Σ w_a · logSum_a, so Δcombined = Σ w_a · Δ_a.
The weights are renormalised over the analysed types (home and types without
an accessibility run are left out). Plots and maps follow `analysis.R`.

```{r combined-setup}
library(sf)

# per-type accessibility results from the cluster (experiment 2026-11-23b-matsim-facs)
facs_dir   <- path.expand("~/public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/de/berlin/projects/autofrei/_dev/2026-11-23b-matsim-facs")
result_dir <- file.path(facs_dir, "results", "20261123-190318-WE9sAp")
output_dir <- file.path(facs_dir, "output", "combined-duration-weighted")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# activities file for the duration shares: the 10pct base run, as in the
# chunk above; falls back to the 1pct baseCtd run if it is not on disk
activity_files <- path.expand(c(
  "~/public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/de/berlin/projects/autofrei/10pct-v6.4/berlin-autofrei-v6.4-baseCaseCtdExtended-10pct/berlin-v6.4.output_activities.csv.zst",
  "~/public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/de/berlin/projects/autofrei/1pct-v6.4/berlin-autofrei-v6.4-baseCtd/berlin-v6.4.output_activities.csv.gz"
))

shape_dir <- path.expand("~/git/matsim-libs/contribs/accessibility/src/main/R/THESIS/input/Berlin shapefiles")
berlin_only <- TRUE  # keep only people whose homes are inside Berlin
beta <- 1

facility_labels <- c(
  work = "Work", work_business = "Work (business)", leisure = "Leisure",
  dining = "Dining", shop_daily = "Shopping (daily)", shop_other = "Shopping (other)",
  personal_business = "Personal business", edu_kiga = "Kindergarten",
  edu_primary = "Primary school", edu_secondary = "Secondary school",
  edu_higher = "Higher education", edu_other = "Other education"
)
activity_types <- intersect(names(facility_labels), list.dirs(file.path(result_dir, "base"), full.names = FALSE))

# same income brackets as analysis.R
income_breaks <- c(-Inf, 500, 900, 1500, 2000, 2600, 3000, 3600, 4600, Inf)
income_labels <- c("500", "900", "1500", "2000", "2600", "3000", "3600", "4600", "5600")
district_levels <- c("Mitte", "Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg", "Pankow", "Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf",
                     "Spandau", "Steglitz-Zehlendorf", "Tempelhof-Schöneberg", "Neukölln",
                     "Treptow-Köpenick", "Marzahn-Hellersdorf", "Lichtenberg", "Reinickendorf")

berlin_sf <- st_read(file.path(shape_dir, "Berlin_Bezirke.shp"), quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(25832)
ring_sf <- st_read(file.path(shape_dir, "Berlin_sbahn_ring.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)
if (is.na(st_crs(ring_sf))) st_crs(ring_sf) <- 4326
ring_sf <- st_transform(ring_sf, 25832)
```

```{r weights}
activity_file <- Find(file.exists, activity_files)
message("Duration shares from ", activity_file)

act_con <- if (str_ends(activity_file, "\\.zst")) pipe(paste("zstd -dc", shQuote(activity_file))) else activity_file

duration_shares <- read_delim(act_con, delim = ";", col_select = c(person, activity_type),
                              col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
  filter(str_starts(person, "berlin")) |>
  separate_wider_regex(activity_type, c(act = ".*", "_", typical_duration = ".*"), cols_remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(typical_duration = as.numeric(typical_duration)) |>
  group_by(act) |>
  summarise(n = n(), typical_duration = sum(typical_duration)) |>
  filter(act != "home") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(typical_duration_share = typical_duration / sum(typical_duration))

weights <- duration_shares |>
  filter(act %in% activity_types) |>
  mutate(weight = typical_duration_share / sum(typical_duration_share)) |>
  arrange(desc(weight))
stopifnot(setequal(weights$act, activity_types))
message("Analysed types cover ", round(100 * sum(weights$typical_duration_share), 1),
        "% of non-home activity time")
write_csv(weights, file.path(output_dir, "weights.csv"))
weights
```

```{r per-type-accessibility}
read_acc <- function(act, scenario, mode) {
  read_csv(file.path(result_dir, scenario, act, paste0("pbAcc_", mode, "_", scenario, "_rawSum.csv")),
           show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(personId = col_character()))
}

# multimodal = log(walk + pt + car) per type; policy reuses base walk and pt
per_type <- map(activity_types, function(act) {
  read_acc(act, "base", "teleportedWalk") |>
    select(personId, age, sex, income, homeX, homeY, walk = accessibility) |>
    inner_join(read_acc(act, "base", "pt") |> select(personId, pt = accessibility), by = "personId") |>
    inner_join(read_acc(act, "base", "car") |> select(personId, car_base = accessibility), by = "personId") |>
    inner_join(read_acc(act, "policy", "car") |> select(personId, car_policy = accessibility), by = "personId") |>
    transmute(
      act, personId, age, sex, income, homeX, homeY,
      mm_logSum_base    = log(walk + pt + car_base) / beta,
      mm_logSum_policy  = log(walk + pt + car_policy) / beta,
      car_logSum_base   = log(car_base) / beta,
      car_logSum_policy = log(car_policy) / beta,
      pt_logSum         = log(pt) / beta,
      twalk_logSum      = log(walk) / beta
    )
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(mm_delta = mm_logSum_policy - mm_logSum_base,
         car_delta = car_logSum_policy - car_logSum_base)
```

```{r combine}
# only persons with a finite value for every type
complete_persons <- per_type |>
  group_by(personId) |>
  summarise(ok = n() == length(activity_types) &&
              all(is.finite(c(mm_logSum_base, mm_logSum_policy, car_logSum_base, car_logSum_policy,
                              pt_logSum, twalk_logSum)))) |>
  filter(ok) |>
  pull(personId)

df_comb <- per_type |>
  filter(personId %in% complete_persons) |>
  inner_join(select(weights, act, weight), by = "act") |>
  group_by(personId, age, sex, income, homeX, homeY) |>
  summarise(across(c(mm_logSum_base, mm_logSum_policy, car_logSum_base, car_logSum_policy,
                     pt_logSum, twalk_logSum),
                   ~ sum(weight * .x)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    mm_delta  = mm_logSum_policy - mm_logSum_base,
    car_delta = car_logSum_policy - car_logSum_base,
    income_raw = as.numeric(income),
    income = cut(income_raw, income_breaks, labels = income_labels, ordered_result = TRUE)
  )

# district, ring and Berlin filter from the home location (as in analysis.R)
homes <- st_as_sf(df_comb, coords = c("homeX", "homeY"), crs = 25832, remove = FALSE)
district_idx <- st_intersects(homes, berlin_sf)
df_comb <- df_comb |>
  mutate(
    district = factor(berlin_sf$Gemeinde_n[map_int(district_idx, ~ .x[1])],
                      levels = district_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    within = if_else(lengths(st_intersects(homes, ring_sf)) > 0, "Within Ring", "Outside Ring")
  )
if (berlin_only) df_comb <- df_comb |> filter(lengths(district_idx) > 0)

message("Combined accessibility for ", nrow(df_comb), " persons")
write_csv(df_comb, file.path(output_dir, "acc_combined.csv"))
```

```{r summaries}
summary_combined <- tibble(

  summarise(population = n(), mean_delta = mean(mm_delta), median_delta = median(mm_delta),

# how much each type contributes to the mean combined change (Berlin persons)
contributions <- per_type |>
  filter(personId %in% df_comb$personId) |>
  group_by(act) |>
  summarise(mean_mm_delta = mean(mm_delta), median_mm_delta = median(mm_delta),
            worsened_pct = 100 * mean(mm_delta < 0)) |>
  inner_join(select(weights, act, weight), by = "act") |>
  mutate(weighted_mm_delta = weight * mean_mm_delta,
         share_of_combined = weighted_mm_delta / sum(weighted_mm_delta),
         label = facility_labels[act]) |>
  arrange(weighted_mm_delta)
write_csv(contributions, file.path(output_dir, "contributions_by_activity.csv"))
contributions
```

```{r maps}
# same −3…3 bins and style as the person maps in analysis.R
# label the outer edges of the open end bins as "< -limit" / "> limit"
open_bin_labels <- function(colour_limit) {
  function(x) {
    out <- format(x, trim = TRUE)
    out[x <= -colour_limit - 1] <- paste0("< ", -colour_limit)
    out[x >=  colour_limit + 1] <- paste0("> ", colour_limit)
    out
  }
}

plot_delta_map <- function(column, mode_label, colour_limit = 3) {
  bbox <- st_bbox(berlin_sf)
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = berlin_sf, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = ring_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_sf(data = st_as_sf(df_comb, coords = c("homeX", "homeY"), crs = 25832),
            aes(color = .data[[column]]), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_steps2(
      low = "#b2182b", mid = "grey92", high = "#2166ac", midpoint = 0,
      # open-ended end bins: everything below -colour_limit / above colour_limit
      breaks = seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, 1), limits = c(-colour_limit - 1, colour_limit + 1),
      labels = open_bin_labels(colour_limit),
      oob = scales::squish, name = "Δ accessibility\n(policy - base, utils)",
      guide = guide_bins(show.limits = TRUE, override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
    labs(title = paste0(mode_label, " accessibility change: policy - base"),
         subtitle = "Combined over activity types, weighted by time spent") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

map_mm <- plot_delta_map("mm_delta", "Multimodal")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "map_persons_mm_policy_minus_base.png"), map_mm, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6.5, bg = "white")
```

# Comparison: combined facilities vs city center

Side-by-side figures for the duration-weighted facility accessibility (above)
and the accessibility of the city center (corner of Unter den Linden /
Friedrichstraße). The city center results come from `analysis.R`: run it with
`opportunities <- c("citycenter")` first, which writes `citycenter/acc.csv`.

Changes (Δ, utils) are comparable and share one axis. Accessibility levels
are not (one destination vs. thousands), so bar plot and ECDF keep their own
axis per panel.

```{r compare-setup}
library(patchwork)

# city center results from analysis.R; the newest acc.csv under this run is used
citycenter_dir <- path.expand("~/public-svn/matsim/scenarios/countries/de/berlin/projects/autofrei/_dev/2026-11-25-citycenter")
citycenter_file <- Sys.glob(file.path(citycenter_dir, "output", "*", "citycenter", "acc.csv"))
citycenter_file <- citycenter_file[which.max(file.mtime(citycenter_file))]
stopifnot(length(citycenter_file) == 1)
message("City center results: ", citycenter_file)

compare_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "compare-citycenter")
dir.create(compare_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

poi_names <- c("Combined facilities", "City center")
compare_cols <- c("personId", "income", "district", "within", "homeX", "homeY",
                  "twalk_logSum", "pt_logSum", "car_logSum_base", "car_logSum_policy",
                  "mm_logSum_base", "mm_logSum_policy", "car_delta", "mm_delta")

citycenter <- read_csv(citycenter_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                       col_types = cols(personId = col_character(), income = col_character()))

df_compare <- bind_rows(
  `Combined facilities` = df_comb |> mutate(income = as.character(income)) |> select(any_of(compare_cols)),
  `City center`         = citycenter |> select(any_of(compare_cols)),
  .id = "poi"
) |>
  mutate(
    poi = factor(poi, levels = poi_names),
    income = factor(income, levels = income_labels, ordered = TRUE),
    district = factor(district, levels = district_levels, ordered = TRUE)
  )

# persons in both: the two runs should use the same 10% sample (seed 4711)
both <- intersect(df_comb$personId, citycenter$personId)
message("Persons: combined ", nrow(df_comb), ", city center ", nrow(citycenter),
        ", in both ", length(both))

# one panel per POI, one legend; shared y for changes, own y for levels
side_by_side <- function(make_plot, file, shared_y = TRUE, width = 12, height = 5.5) {
  plots <- map(poi_names, function(p) make_plot(filter(df_compare, poi == p)) + labs(title = p))
  plots[[2]] <- plots[[2]] + labs(y = NULL)
  combined <- wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (shared_y) {
    y_range <- range(unlist(map(plots, ~ layer_scales(.x)$y$range$range)), na.rm = TRUE)
    combined <- combined & coord_cartesian(ylim = y_range)
  }
  ggsave(file.path(compare_dir, file), combined, dpi = 300, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
  combined
}
```

```{r compare-bar}
# median accessibility by income, mode & scenario (no walking, PT repeated in Policy)
bar_compare <- function(d) {
  d |>
    transmute(
      income,
      `Public transport|Base` = pt_logSum, `Public transport|Policy` = pt_logSum,
      `Car|Base` = car_logSum_base, `Car|Policy` = car_logSum_policy,
      `Multimodal|Base` = mm_logSum_base, `Multimodal|Policy` = mm_logSum_policy
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(-income, names_to = c("mode", "scenario"), names_sep = "\\|", values_to = "acc") |>
    mutate(mode = factor(mode, levels = c("Public transport", "Car", "Multimodal"))) |>
    group_by(scenario, income, mode) |>
    summarise(median_accessibility = median(acc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(income, median_accessibility, fill = mode)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 1) +
    labs(x = "Income group", y = "Median accessibility (utils)", fill = "Mode") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
side_by_side(bar_compare, "bar_medianacc_by_income_mode_scenario.png", shared_y = FALSE, height = 6)
```

```{r compare-box, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 5}
box_compare <- function(column, ylab, ring = FALSE) {
  function(d) {
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(income, .data[[column]])) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, fill = "white", size = 2.5) +
      labs(x = "Income group", y = ylab) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    if (ring) p <- p + facet_grid(~ within)
    p
  }
}
side_by_side(box_compare("mm_delta", mm_lab), "boxplot_mm_deltaacc_by_income.png", width = 16, height = 5)
side_by_side(box_compare("car_delta", car_lab), "boxplot_car_deltaacc_by_income.png", width = 16, height = 5)
side_by_side(box_compare("mm_delta", mm_lab, ring = TRUE), "boxplot_mm_deltaacc_by_income_ring.png", width = 16, height = 5)
side_by_side(box_compare("car_delta", car_lab, ring = TRUE), "boxplot_car_deltaacc_by_income_ring.png", width = 16, height = 5)
```

```{r compare-ecdf}
ecdf_compare <- function(d) {
  e <- d |>
    select(Base = mm_logSum_base, Policy = mm_logSum_policy) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "scenario", values_to = "accessibility") |>
    filter(is.finite(accessibility))
  ggplot(e, aes(accessibility, colour = scenario, linetype = scenario)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9), colour = "grey80", linetype = "dotted") +
    stat_ecdf(geom = "step", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Base = "#434343", Policy = "#2166ac")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(quantile(e$accessibility, 0.01), NA), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Multimodal accessibility (utils)", y = "Cumulative share of persons",
         colour = NULL, linetype = NULL)
}
side_by_side(ecdf_compare, "ecdf_mm_base_vs_policy.png", shared_y = FALSE)
```

```{r compare-maps}
# same bins as the single maps; one legend for both
map_compare <- function(column, colour_limit = 3) {
  function(d) {
    bbox <- st_bbox(berlin_sf)
    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = berlin_sf, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_sf(data = st_as_sf(filter(d, is.finite(.data[[column]])),
                              coords = c("homeX", "homeY"), crs = 25832),
              aes(color = .data[[column]]), size = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
      # ring on top of the points, so it stays visible in dense areas
      geom_sf(data = ring_sf, fill = NA, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
      scale_color_steps2(
        low = "#b2182b", mid = "grey92", high = "#2166ac", midpoint = 0,
        breaks = seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, 1), limits = c(-colour_limit - 1, colour_limit + 1),
        labels = open_bin_labels(colour_limit), oob = scales::squish,
        name = "Δ accessibility\n(policy - base, utils)",
        guide = guide_bins(show.limits = TRUE, override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))
      ) +
      coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  }
}
side_by_side(map_compare("mm_delta"), "map_persons_mm_policy_minus_base.png", shared_y = FALSE, height = 6)
side_by_side(map_compare("car_delta"), "map_persons_car_policy_minus_base.png", shared_y = FALSE, height = 6)
```
